items.information: Cubing is returning to Aachen after a long 13 year wait! Thanks to the Katholische Hochschulgemeinde Aachen, we are able to host a competition in the heart of the city - the venue is only a few hundred metres away from the famous Aachen Dom, the main university buildings and has plenty of restaurants in the surrounding area. We, the organizing team, look forward to your participation! Nach 13 Jahren kehrt das Cubing nach Aachen zurück! Dank der Katholischen Hochschulgemeinde Aachen können wir einen Wettbewerb im Herzen der Stadt ausrichten - die Venue ist nur wenige hundert Meter vom berühmten Aachener Dom und den Hauptgebäuden der Universität entfernt und verfügt über zahlreiche Restaurants in der Umgebung. Wir, das Orga-Team, freuen uns auf eure Teilnahme!

items.information: ![](https://www.worldcubeassociation.org/rails/active_storage/blobs/redirect/eyJfcmFpbHMiOnsibWVzc2FnZSI6IkJBaHBBcnlIIiwiZXhwIjpudWxsLCJwdXIiOiJibG9iX2lkIn19--332177ea99a8c8d5f8b82db10b1ac1f7c00234a9/io%20(1).png) ###### Español ¡Bienvenidos al Ameca Nayarit 2025, la primera competencia oficial en el hermoso entorno costero y tropical de Nuevo Nayarit, y la segunda en el municipio de Bahía de Banderas! Este evento emocionante y lleno de velocidad se llevará a cabo los dias 18 y 19 de enero del 2025. A medida que el río fluye, también lo hará la emoción de ver a los competidores resolver el cubo Rubik con asombrosa rapidez. Prepárense para estas jornadas inolvidables llenas de ingenio y velocidad. Esta competencia es organizada por la comunidad de Vallarta Speed. Esta competencia es reconocida como una competencia de la Asociación Mundial del Cubo. Por lo tanto, todos los competidores deben estar familiarizados y entender el [reglamento de la WCA](https://www.worldcubeassociation.org/regulations/translations/spanish-american/) antes de la competencia. ###### English Welcome to the Ameca Nayarit 2025, the first official competition in the beautiful coastal and tropical environment of Nuevo Nayarit, and the second in the municipality of Bahía de Banderas! This exciting and fast-paced event will take place on January 18 and 19, 2025. As the river flows, so will the thrill of watching competitors solve the Rubik's Cube with astonishing speed. Get ready for these unforgettable days full of ingenuity and speed. This competition is organized by the Vallarta Speed community. This competition is recognized as a World Cube Association competition. Therefore, all competitors must be familiar with and understand the [WCA regulations](https://www.worldcubeassociation.org/regulations/) before the competition.

items.name: Gdańska Liga Speedcubingu I 2025
items.information: Gdańska Liga Speedcubingu to speedcuberska inicjatywa z najdłuższymi tradycjami i niezwykłą historią. Od 2008 roku w różnych lokalizacjach nasze wspaniałe miasto gościło ponad 60 turniejów w oficjalnej formule World Cube Association, w, których łącznie wzięło udział kilka tysięcy zawodników z całego kraju. --- Gdańsk Speedcubing League is an speedcubing initiative with long tradition and extraordinary history. Since 2008 in several different locations our city hosted more than 60 official WCA competitions, where few thousands of competitors could have done their attempts.

items.information: ### 참가비 결제를 완료하였더라도 선착순에 의해 정원에 들지 못하면 대기자 명단에 등록됩니다. ### 신청 후 [참가자 명단](https://payment.kccu.info/competition/55/competitors)에서 본인의 이름을 확인하십시오. 이름이 보이지 않을 경우 [대기자 명단](https://payment.kccu.info/competition/55/waitlist)을 확인하여 주십시오. ### 주최 측에서 발송하는 이메일을 꼭 확인 하시기를 바랍니다. 모든 참가자는 [WCA 규정](https://www.worldcubeassociation.org/regulations/)을 숙지하여야 합니다. WCA 규정 [1e2](https://www.worldcubeassociation.org/regulations/#1e2)와 [1f2](https://www.worldcubeassociation.org/regulations/#1f2)에 따라, 모든 참가자는 운영진의 요청이 있을 시 스태프 업무를 수행해야 합니다. 원할한 스태프 업무 수행을 위하여 [스태프 규정 영상](https://youtu.be/3saR3HMi4JM?si=QdOG0tvo_5CvoDCz)을 시청하여 주십시오. 원할한 기록 측정을 위하여 [WCA 규정 및 타이머 사용 안내 영상](https://youtu.be/bKzz_YBVi7s?si=W0dGxSrqfmIaLJF1)을 시청하여 주십시오. ___ ### Even if you successfully paid the registration fee, due to the first-come first-served basis for registration, you might be put on the waitlist. ### After registration, please check your name on the [competitor list](https://payment.kccu.info/en/competition/55/competitors). Please check the [wait list](https://payment.kccu.info/en/competition/55/waitlist) if your name is not on the competitor list. ### Please be sure to check the emails sent by the organizers. All competitors must be familiar with the [WCA Regulations](https://www.worldcubeassociation.org/regulations/). Due to the WCA Regulations [1e2](https://www.worldcubeassociation.org/regulations/#1e2) and [1f2](https://www.worldcubeassociation.org/regulations/#1f2), all competitors are required to fulfill staff duties if requested by organizers. Please watch [this video](https://youtu.be/bKzz_YBVi7s?si=W0dGxSrqfmIaLJF1) if you are not familiar with the official WCA competition.

items.name: SacQuiet Winter 2025
items.information: ![Image description](https://b2b989d215c701ad63d7-288404e13f895703cf2798bf6ae95228.ssl.cf1.rackcdn.com/734655566969-350.png) ![](https://www.worldcubeassociation.org/rails/active_storage/blobs/redirect/eyJfcmFpbHMiOnsibWVzc2FnZSI6IkJBaHBBZ0dKIiwiZXhwIjpudWxsLCJwdXIiOiJibG9iX2lkIn19--60fae70c3e469b91d58257f4370c58af47b487da/scswcc5.png) #### From the organizers that brought you SacCubing, comes SacQuiet Winter 2025! #### **This competition will be specializing in quiet events and will not have 3x3 or any traditional events.** If you would like to sign up for a competition involving those events, please check out [SacCubing XIX 2024,](https://www.worldcubeassociation.org/competitions/SacCubingXIX2025/) happening on January 19th, the day after. * *If we run ahead of schedule, we will start first round events no earlier than 20 minutes, so please show up at least 20 minutes before your first event.* * We will be assigning judging assignments to competitors for the group before or after their own competing groups. Please check your personal competitor cards when we assign them a week before the competition date for relevant info. * All donations are appreciated and will go towards things such as venue fees, supplies and other competition expenses.

items.information: This competition is supported by [Southeast Cubing, Inc.](https://southeastcubing.org/about)! **Please check out the Southeast Cubing, Inc. tab to learn more about the official nonprofit organization for speedcubing in the Southeast and what you can do to support the mission.** ​ ![](https://www.worldcubeassociation.org/rails/active_storage/blobs/redirect/eyJfcmFpbHMiOnsiZGF0YSI6Mzc5MDYsInB1ciI6ImJsb2JfaWQifX0=--55d04463db7d97e68854ce1ad4ffb960c1ed23fd/SOUTHEAST_5.png) This competition is made possible with partnersips with [CubingUSA](https://www.cubingusa.org) and Vanderbilt Cube Club. Please make sure to read the **[Venue, Travel, and Lunch](https://www.worldcubeassociation.org/competitions/VanderbiltSpring2024#37497-venue-travel-and-lunch)** tab for information about parking and food. ## MINORS POLICY: A parent or guardian MUST be present at check-in for anyone under the age of 18 who plans to compete. Vanderbilt University requires all minors (persons under the age of 18) attending this competition to be accompanied by a parent or guardian. All participants under the age of 18 must fill out the form linked below: # https://forms.gle/cFt7i8vmK9yEA7U2A **We reserve the right to deny entry into the venue if you have not filled out the form.**
